errors.quote: The no-added-substrate arm removes replacement by endogenous unlabelled carbon.
errors.issue: This subtraction assumes endogenous replacement is unchanged when S is added. S can itself alter pool mobilization and exchange, so the no-S arm cannot guarantee removal of that contribution.

A single dilution constant times a maintained pool estimates replacement under model assumptions, not uniquely net cyclic flux. Compare full time-resolved cyclic, branched and exchange models with identifiability and absolute carbon constraints; positional map comparison alone is incomplete.

errors.quote: wash out soluble intermediates and cofactors until target pools are below quantification
errors.issue: Washing small metabolites does not define the enzyme composition or remove alternate catalytic routes. Supply a concrete purified/compositionally defined enzyme system and cofactor/electron-acceptor inventory.

The final plan still defers the actual tissue preparation, substrate, isotope positions and enzyme identities. Calibration appropriately replaces unknown numeric settings, but a usable proposed biochemical implementation remains absent.

rationale: Good reciprocal labeling, independent units, step-activity panel, calibrated margins and allowance for mixed mechanisms. Label dilution is not necessarily net return; subtraction and washed reconstitution leave important unresolved alternatives.
reference_guardrails: Personally read the complete final answer, exact question/packet and entire frozen reference answer including its curator clarification. No hidden reasoning, paid judge or laboratory execution.
This uses the existing first-round rubric. The owner requested a stricter second round only after completion of this round; new 10/5-point deductions have not been applied.
The packet explicitly says the 1937 full text and figures were not read. Do not attribute proposed experimental details to the historical paper or penalize absence of invented historical settings.

The preliminary key mentions a noncycling analog and a small fixed discovery n. Its clarification permits omission/restoration where no validated analog exists. Independent sample size should be powered/calibrated; no particular small n is required.
Do not demand a positive addition effect in an already saturated endogenous pool. Failure to meet a proposed support gate limits the conclusion and does not automatically falsify cycling.

Adding downstream carbon around an irreversible block does not restore the missing reaction. Label exchange or appearance in one pool does not establish net cycle flux; respiration alone is insufficient.

Initial pools, mobilizable reserves, carbon sources, washout losses, cofactor-regeneration reactions and reversible exchange need accounting. Carbon closure alone cannot distinguish all network topologies.
Unknown numeric settings can be calibrated; concrete proposed biochemical routes are nevertheless useful. No complete primary-source methods audit is claimed.

Additional correction: isotope enrichment or residual starting tracer is not return flux; one-way replenishment and reversible exchange can coexist with oxidation. Stable carrier amount can coexist with loss of its original carbon atoms.

A closed-cycle proposal needs appropriate carbon mapping, multi-turn dynamics and identifiable alternative networks. CO2 release can be partial decarboxylation. Define stoichiometric units and handle a near-zero ratio denominator explicitly.

No-substrate controls do not guarantee additive endogenous flux under added substrate. Include measured convertible pools and mobilizable reserves in finite-pool alternatives. Biological background is not an automatic QC exclusion.

Heat-inactivated controls do not exclude contaminating enzymes in an active preparation. Washed or enzyme-depleted crude fractions are not automatically compositionally defined enzyme reconstitutions.
Unknown settings may be calibrated and scientifically valid equivalent contrasts accepted; no fixed author recipe, unavailable analog, mandatory small n, or new round-two deductions imposed.

Reviewer checked indexed primary-paper excerpts on arsenite inhibition of both PDH and KGDH and on exchanging pools in TCA isotope modeling. PMC full-page access was challenged; no full-text or source-methods audit is claimed.
